facts.fact: BCEAO instruction no. 001-01-2024, applied since January 2024, obliges all fintechs offering payment services in the WAEMU, which includes Cote d'Ivoire, to obtain a licence or stop; the deadline was extended to 31 August 2025 (TechCabal, 17 Feb 2026).

BCEAO instruction no. 001-01-2024 licenses payment institutions that are not banks at three tiers by capital (CFA 10, 20 or 100 million), valid across the eight WAEMU states including Cote d'Ivoire; 20 payment institutions held a licence union-wide by September 2025 (TechCabal, 17 Feb 2026).

systems.tiers: mentioned as interoperable payment platform; 86 institutions at launch per the document
